headline: Major AI Chatbots ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok experience widespread outages
summary: Users reported issues with OpenAI's ChatGPT and Grok, as well as Anthropic's Claude, leading to widespread disruption for AI services.
details: Multiple leading AI chatbots, including OpenAI's ChatGPT and Grok, and Anthropic's Claude, have been affected by significant outages.
Users across various platforms reported experiencing errors and unavailability, with OpenAI's status page confirming issues with ChatGPT and Codex.
Grok's service also acknowledged experiencing operational problems, while Anthropic's status page indicated elevated error rates for Claude.
The simultaneous disruption across these major AI services raised questions among users about potential coincidental failures or a larger systemic issue.
Fortunately, the outages appear to be temporary, with services gradually coming back online for users.
caption:
ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok are all down. Major AI services experienced widespread outages today, impacting millions of users.

Multiple leading AI chatbots, including OpenAI's ChatGPT and Grok, and Anthropic's Claude, have been affected by significant outages.

Users across various platforms reported experiencing errors and unavailability, with OpenAI's status page confirming issues with ChatGPT and Codex.

Grok's service also acknowledged experiencing operational problems, while Anthropic's status page indicated elevated error rates for Claude.

The simultaneous disruption across these major AI services raised questions among users about potential coincidental failures or a larger systemic issue.

Fortunately, the outages appear to be temporary, with services gradually coming back online for users.

#AI #ChatGPT #Claude #Grok #Outage

Source: Hacker News

headline_marked: Google launches [[AI voice features]] in Gmail, Docs, and Keep
headline: Google launches AI voice features in Gmail, Docs, and Keep
summary: Ask questions about your inbox, draft documents with AI, and dictate notes hands-free across Google's productivity suite.
details: Google is rolling out new conversational AI features, dubbed Docs Live, Gmail Live, and Keep Live, to its popular productivity apps. These tools allow users to interact with their content using natural language queries and voice dictation, making tasks more efficient.

In Gmail, users can now ask a Gemini-powered AI assistant questions about their inbox contents instead of relying solely on the search bar. The interface provides a live transcript of the interaction.
Docs Live empowers users to describe their writing needs, and the AI will assist in creating a first draft. It can also pull information from Gmail, Drive, chat, and the web to inform the draft.
Keep Live functions as a smart scratchpad. Users can dictate notes without typing, and the AI can help generate lists or recipes, such as compiling ingredients for a dish like shakshouka.

Gmail Live is accessible to Google AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra customers. Docs Live and Keep Live are available for Google AI Pro and Ultra users. All features are launching in English on iOS and Android, with Workplace Business customers to follow soon.

This expansion follows Google's recent integration of voice-based features across its ecosystem, including cross-app dictation for Mac and the Gemini-powered Rambler tool for Pixel smartphones that removes filler words.
